subject.title: feat: Let users steer running ACP/sub-agent sessions from Discord (and other chat surfaces)

question: Should the remaining same-session active-turn admission fix proceed through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89238, a maintainer replacement branch, or a narrower redesign at a different channel/runtime boundary?
rationale: The source-level issue is valid, but the fix changes session-state and message-delivery ordering and an open proof-positive candidate PR already exists with outstanding review concerns.

options.title: Refresh the open candidate PR
options.body: Have the branch preserve current-main terminal-session recovery and fix the accepted-queue fallback concern before another merge review.

options.title: Open a maintainer replacement
options.body: Replace the contributor branch only if maintainers want to own the session/admission semantics directly while preserving attribution.

options.title: Redesign the boundary
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers choose a different post-context ingress or channel-runtime ownership split.

recommendation.title: Refresh the open candidate PR
recommendation.body: Have the branch preserve current-main terminal-session recovery and fix the accepted-queue fallback concern before another merge review.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the current partial steer fix and are the clearest history-backed owner for deciding the next admission-layer path.
